summary: Describes the preferred design of a Pseudowire Emulation Edge-to-Edge control word for use over an MPLS network, along with the pseudowire associated channel header. The fields are chosen so a label switching router that inspects payloads will not mistake a pseudowire payload for an IP packet. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: A small marker at the front of a package so routers that peek inside do not mistake a wrapped old-style message for ordinary internet mail.
